verdict.rationale: Glama's core value prop is a searchable catalog ('Search, compare, and connect to thousands of MCP servers') with 91,626 servers and 23,749 connectors indexed, capability inspection via the browser inspector, and per-server config blocks for quick wiring into agents. Community evidence corroborates real usage of the catalog and scoring system, though one comment notes it's easy to get lost among many listings. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of search/filter quality by capability beyond text search.
